message: Last week, we had an unexpected power outage, and for once, I was the prepared one! I dug out my trusty flashlight and power bank, feeling like a superhero in my own living room. As we played board games by lantern light, I realized how nice it is to have a little backup plan. It turned a potentially frustrating night into a cozy adventure! What’s your favorite tip for staying comfy during a blackout? 😊
